purpose: baseline of 0.7.0 (stored-result diagnostics; release gates use the interleaved A/B against the 0.6.1 source tree)
methodology: schema 2.2, Harness V3 (5 warm-ups, 3 x 7 batches, >= 50 ms per sample, median-of-medians), repeatability over 3 complete runs x 31 families, interleaved A/B vs the 0.6.1 source tree (3 batches per side, alternating order), JVM side of the ffi gates from `gradle -p jvm :ace-native:ffiBenchmark`

verdict.repeatability: pass, deterministic values identical over 3 runs x 31 families; macro spread <= 5 % (compression, observed maximum 1.8 %) / <= 15 % (decompression, observed maximum 11.6 %)
verdict.ab_vs_0_6_1: pass, 20 / 20 cases, minimum speed ratio 0.991 (numeric_fast.u32_counter decode), byte-identical output on every case
verdict.ffi: pass; C ABI vs Rust facade on 16 MiB: compress 1.008x, decompress 1.008x (gate >= 0.97x); JVM zero-copy vs facade: compress 1.020x, decompress 0.936x (gate >= 0.90x)

files: benchmark-0.7.0-<family>.json (incl. regression, repeatability, ffi), ab-0.7.0-vs-0.6.1.json and ffi-jvm-0.7.0.json, unchanged from the run
note: reference run of the 0.7.0 release on the author's workstation (performance governor, 37 C); code revision 3492a07, clean tree. 0.7.0 writes the same bytes as 0.6.1, so the A/B compares speed only. JVM zero-copy decompress varies between 0.90x and 0.97x of the facade over runs (the 3.4 ms call includes the native buffer's shared-arena release); the 0.90x gate held in this run (0.936x), see docs/PERFORMANCE-0.7.0.md.
